Package aor.proj3t.resource

Class ImageUploadResource

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.resource.ImageUploadResource
@Path("/users/{userId}/profile") @RequestScoped public class ImageUploadResource extends Object
REST resource for user profile image upload and management.

Handles uploading, validating, and storing profile pictures for users. This resource parses multipart form data, enforces file type and size restrictions, and delegates storage logic to the user service layer.

  • Method Details

    • uploadProfilePicture

      @POST @Path("/picture") @Consumes("multipart/form-data") @Produces("application/json") public jakarta.ws.rs.core.Response uploadProfilePicture(@PathParam("userId") Long userId, org.jboss.resteasy.plugins.providers.multipart.MultipartFormDataInput input, @HeaderParam("Authorization") String authHeader)
      Uploads a profile picture for the specified user. Validates file format, size, MIME type, and extracts metadata. Only the authenticated user or an admin may upload images.
      Parameters:
      userId - the ID of the user whose profile picture is being updated
      input - multipart form input containing the image file
      authHeader - the authorization header with the bearer token
      Returns:
      a response indicating success or failure of upload

    • resetProfilePicture

      @DELETE @Path("/picture") @Produces("application/json") public jakarta.ws.rs.core.Response resetProfilePicture(@PathParam("userId") Long userId, @HeaderParam("Authorization") String authHeader)
      Deletes the user's profile picture, resetting it to the default image. Only the user themselves or an admin may perform this operation.
      Parameters:
      userId - the ID of the user whose picture is to be reset
      authHeader - the bearer token from the request
      Returns:
      a response indicating whether the reset was successful

    • getProfilePicture

      @GET @Path("/picture") @Produces("image/*") public jakarta.ws.rs.core.Response getProfilePicture(@PathParam("userId") Long userId)
      Retrieves the user's profile picture. If no custom image is found, returns the default profile image.
      Parameters:
      userId - the ID of the user whose picture is being requested
      Returns:
      an image stream with proper caching and content headers
